obstacle_actions.scrolling: Agree a concrete stopping point before starting. Do not open another feed afterwards; prepare your alternative.
obstacle_actions.availability: Check which people and essential apps must remain available. Test this before enabling blocking.
obstacle_actions.thoughts: Briefly record what you want to address later. You do not need to solve it now. Then choose one simple calm action.
obstacle_actions.planning: Connect today’s action to an event in your day instead of an impossible fixed hour. Adjust the reminder when necessary.
obstacle_actions.alarm: First check that your alarm is set and audible. Use a separate alarm clock when available and do not block essential alarm functions.
obstacle_actions.no_routine: Connect the action to something you already do. Keep the new step small enough to try today.
